name: com.spatialai.sdk
description: Spatial runtime contracts, device profile selection, simulator, and an optional Cardboard XR baseline sample.

samples.description: Create a simulator scene using Spatial AI > Create Simulator Scene after importing this sample.

Requires Cardboard XR Plugin 1.30.0 or newer, Input System and XR Plug-in Management. The RhinoX Pro optical reference is applied on the known development device; per-unit calibration remains pending.
